t_advice_summary_textbox.text: purple and brown are the most effective gnomes, avoid blue, yellow and green ones. x5 multipliers are very important. be quick to choose the gnomes

vb_textbox.text: The best advice I can give is to make your gnome decisions quickly, particularly when the multiplier is x5! Keep yur fingers on the buttons. The colours of the gnomes do not seem to correspond to anything but I found that blue, purple and brown often gathered the most mushrooms.  Avoid orange ones. The numbers of mushrooms gathered by each gnome varies greatly between 0 and 40
